info.name: Limble API V2 Assets Webhooks API

params.name: webhooks
params.description: This parameter is used to only get specific Webhooks. This parameter expects a comma delimited list of webhookIDs.

params.name: endpoint
params.description: This parameter is used for a string search by the webhook endpoint. This parameter expects a URL or partial URL of a webhook using a string with the wildcard %.

params.name: type
params.description: This parameter is used to only get Webhooks of a specific type. This parameter accepts a comma delimited list of webhook types.

params.name: enabled
params.description: This parameter is used to get Webooks which are enabled. This paramter expects 1: Enabled or 0: Disabled

params.name: cursor
params.description: This parameter is a cursor that selects what webhookID you want to start receiving results at. e.g. passing 10 here will only get you webhooks with an id greater than 10.

params.name: limit
params.description: This parameter is a result limiter. The default is set to return no more than 100 results at one time.

items.docs:
This request returns your Webhooks configured for Limble. 

Return data description

Property: webhhokID, Description: The ID of the Webhook
Property: endpoint, Description: The webhook URL.
Property: type, Description: The type of webhook. Webhooks can be of type task, po, poItem.
Property: enabled, Description: Determines if the webhook is enabled. 0 = Disabled 1=Enabled
